name: Heisler Semiconductor LLC
old_description: Circuit and hardware design, firmware, advanced packaging, wafer-level, laser, and supply chain — backed by data and AI-assisted process control. One engineering team takes it from concept through volume, on US soil.
about:
Heisler Semiconductor operates a process and assembly lab in Halethorpe, Maryland. The company is a US-based, engineering-led advanced packaging team; no founding year or individual founders are disclosed in public materials.

The lab provides advanced packaging and wafer-level services including die attach, wire bonding, flip chip, hermetic sealing, and 3D integration; wafer-level processing such as lithography, TSV, deposition, etch, CMP, and RDL; laser micromachining for micro-vias, dicing, singulation, and marking; and inspection and metrology via X-ray, 3D AOI, SEM, and sub-micron metrology. The same engineering team also handles circuit, device, and hardware design, firmware development, RF evaluation boards, and domestic supply-chain management from prototype through qualified volume.

Heisler serves aerospace and defense, medical and bio, RF/mmWave, and advanced sensor programs where domestic provenance and high-reliability assembly are required. Customers include companies building MEMS, sensors, GaN and CMOS mixed-signal devices, and fine-pitch multi-die modules.

The company emphasizes a data-driven, AI-native approach: designed experiments (DOE) and statistical process control on every build, with AI surfacing drift and correlations to reduce trial-and-error iterations. All development and build work remains on US soil under an NDA-first policy, and the engineers who scope a job own it through qualification.
